python3 -c "
import json, sys
counts = {}
tokens = {}
with open('/Users/Private/Documents/Code/ProjectHana/.workflow/telemetry/hooks-2026-06-27.jsonl') as f:
    for line in f:
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
            t = r.get('tool_name','?')
            counts[t] = counts.get(t,0) + 1
            tok = r.get('est_tokens', 0) or 0
            tokens[t] = tokens.get(t,0) + tok
        except: pass
for k in sorted(counts, key=lambda x: -counts[x]):
    avg = tokens[k]//counts[k] if counts[k] else 0
    print(f'{k}: {counts[k]} calls, avg {avg} est_tokens')
" 2>/dev/null
